summary: The 'MaintGoverningOrg' module is a part of an application used to manage governing organizations. It includes functionalities for viewing, adding, editing, deleting, and reactivating organizations. The module also handles data validation and user permissions for managing these organizations.
purpose: To provide an interface for managing governing organizations, including viewing, editing, and handling inactive states, while ensuring data integrity and proper user permissions.

actors.permissions: Full access to edit and manage organizations.
Read-only access unless given specific permissions.

workflows.name: Organization Management
steps: Check user permissions for edit access.
Allow adding/editing/deleting organizations based on permissions.
Validate user inputs for organization details.
Save or update organization details in the system.

business_rules: Only system administrators can edit or manage organizations.
Phone and Fax numbers must be validated using the specified mask.
validations: Name and ShortName fields are required.
PreviousNameEffectiveDate must match the specified date format.
conditions: Screen is editable if the user is a system administrator and not in view-only mode.
system_behavior: Show or hide buttons based on user permissions and entity states.
Refresh data view after any data modification.
dependencies: UserSession for managing user permissions and settings.
exceptions: Cannot delete an organization that is currently in use.
